newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Tuesday, as active technical buying emerged following a sharp fall in prices on Monday, traders said.
Prices were 10 to 310 yen higher, and the benchmark September 1997 contract was up 310 yen at 15,500 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 122,815 lots.

Local investors bought after determining Monday's price plunges were excessive, the traders said. "Buying orders accelerated in the late afternoon," a brokerage house trader said. All months of Tokyo corn futures plunged by the daily 500 yen limit by the close on Monday.
